title: The Truth of Ten Thousand Years Ago
next_chapter_hook: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly solidified, and in those eyes that had witnessed the passage of countless years, memories from ten thousand years ago emerged—he had once been the scribe of the List of Destiny, inscribing the life and death of countless souls.

text.content:
The air in the depths of the ruins seemed to have solidified for ten thousand years. Chen Ji felt a torrent of information sweeping across his consciousness. What was happening with Han Lie was beyond his concern—at this moment, a massive screen of light was slowly unfolding before him.

It was a list, or rather, a scroll filled with names and fates. Beside each name were annotations of birth dates, bloodlines, and strings of mysterious runes. Chen Ji's gaze swept across it, and the earliest date赫然 was—ten thousand years ago.

dialogue.content:
Do you see it? Mo Xiansheng's voice rang out from the void, carrying a weight Chen Ji had never heard before, "This list was personally drafted by Chen Tianming ten thousand years ago and entrusted to my care."

His remnant soul phantom materialized beside Chen Ji, his gaze falling upon the top of the list where a name was surrounded by golden light—Chen Tianming.

text.content:
Chen Ji's fingers trembled as they slid downward. Not from fear, but from an inexplicable premonition seizing his heart. The list's arrangement was not arbitrary, but followed a pattern of bloodline continuity—every first name in each generation was Chen Tianming's direct descendant.

First Generation: Chen Tianming.
Second Generation: Chen Tianming's Son.
Third Generation...
Fourth Generation...

Chen Ji continued looking down, his breathing gradually growing rapid.

dialogue.content:
"Brother..." Chen Nian's voice came from behind him, gentle yet carrying an undetectable tremor, "What are you looking at?"

Chen Ji turned abruptly, seeing Chen Nian standing not far away, her moon-white robes particularly conspicuous in the dim ruins. Her eyes reflected the screen of light, her expression complex and indecipherable.

text.content:
Chen Ji did not answer, but continued looking at the lower part of the list. Beside the fifteenth generation's name were two characters—Chen Ji. And below Chen Ji's name was a line of small text he had never noticed before:

"Heavenly Fate Key, born to inherit destiny, sacrificing oneself to fulfill the path, only then can the situation be broken."

He looked up sharply, toward Chen Nian's name—

Beside Chen Nian's name was赫然 written the same annotation.

dialogue.content:
"Now do you understand?" Mo Xiansheng's voice sounded in Chen Ji's ear, "Ten thousand years ago, Chen Tianming foresaw that the Tianji Record would eventually shatter, so he injected the last strand of Heavenly Fate Power into his own bloodline. He left two choices—"

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul drifted before Chen Ji, and for the first time, a hint of apology appeared in those ancient eyes: "First, you two siblings jointly bear this Heavenly Fate, continuing the inheritance of the Tianji Record; second, one of you sacrifices yourself to transfer all Heavenly Fate to the other."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a thunderclap echo through his mind.

He remembered Chen Xuan's dying words: "Child, you are not atrash (waste), you are the破局者 (game-breaker) destined ten thousand years ago." At the time, he had taken it as mere comfort; only now did he understand the true meaning of those words.

Histrash (waste) persona, his accidental acquisition of the Tianji Record Fragment, all his scheming over these years—it turned out that from the very beginning, he had been placed into a chess game woven ten thousand years ago.

dialogue.content:
"Brother, what are you thinking?" Chen Nian walked to Chen Ji's side, gently grasping his hand, "Whatever is written on that list, I won't let you bear it alone."

Her voice was soft, yet carried undeniable resolve. Chen Ji looked down at this long-lost sister, a surge of indescribable bitterness rising in his heart. She had been taken by the Holy Sect for years, enduring torment, yet never resented this brother who had failed to protect her.

choice.prompt: Facing the fate arrangement from ten thousand years ago, Chen Ji needed to make the first choice—

choices.description: Since it was destined ten thousand years ago, then face it calmly, turn passivity into proactivity, and continue playing this game.
choices.visible_cost: The possibility of losing some autonomy
choices.visible_reward: Gain the blessing of Heavenly Fate Power left by Chen Tianming
choices.risk_hint: Potentially be completely bound by fate

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, slowly closing his eyes. When he opened them again, a faint golden glow had appeared in his eyes—that was the recognition of Chen Tianming's residual will. The annotations beside the names on the list suddenly lit up, and a new line of text appeared beside Chen Ji's name: "The Destiny Bearer has taken position, the chess game restarts."

choices.description: How could someone from ten thousand years ago decide his fate? He wanted to personally break this scripted destiny.
choices.visible_cost: May provoke the will of the Tianji Record
choices.risk_hint: The Tianji Record may retract the abilities it granted

text.content: Chen Ji laughed coldly, his gaze fixed directly on the screen of light: "An arrangement from ten thousand years ago? I'd like to see who the true chess player is on this board." As his words fell, the characters on the list actually trembled slightly, as if responding to his defiance. Mo Xiansheng watched this scene, a flash of appreciation flickering in his eyes.

Just then, a rumbling sound came from the depths of the ruins. A phantom light figure emerged from the stone wall—a venerable old man with white hair, his face kind yet carrying an air of authority. When Chen Ji saw that face, his heart contracted sharply—that face bore a seventy percent resemblance to the Chen Xuan in his memory.

dialogue.content:
"This is... Chen Tianming's remnant consciousness left in the ruins." Mo Xiansheng's voice turned reverent, "Ten thousand years ago, when he drafted this list, he left behind a testament."

The old man's phantom slowly opened his mouth, his voice aged yet clear: "My descendants, if you can hear these words, it means the inheritance of the Tianji Record has not been severed. Remember, every name on this list is a piece in Heaven's chess game—but beneath the chess game, there are still variables."

text.content:
Chen Ji's breath nearly stopped.

Chen Tianming's testament continued to echo within the ruins: "The chess game laid out by the Heavenly Eye seems flawless, but it made one mistake—it treats all pieces as emotionless tools. It doesn't know that every single piece has the possibility to break free from the chessboard."

The old man's light shadow smiled faintly: "Your sister is the Heavenly Fate Key; you are the Heavenly Fate Breaker. The entanglement of your two fates is what will break this ten-thousand-year chess game."

dialogue.content:
Chen Nian's eyes reddened slightly at these words. She turned to look at Chen Ji and softly said, "Brother, so our meeting wasn't by coincidence."

Chen Ji didn't speak, only reaching out to grasp Chen Nian's hand. That hand was somewhat cold, yet it caused a warm current to surge in Chen Ji's heart. After years of separation, each having endured suffering, they finally reunited in these ten-thousand-year-old ruins—this was perhaps fate's gentlest gift.

choice.prompt: Facing Chen Tianming's testament, Chen Ji had to make a response—

choices.text: Solemnly promise to protect his sister
choices.description: Since fate demanded they bear it together, they would walk forward hand in hand, regardless of how many thorns lay ahead, they would walk through it together.
choices.visible_cost: Bear more risks for his sister's safety
choices.visible_reward: Establish a "Shared Fate" bond with Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May expose weaknesses due to protecting his sister

text.content:
Chen Ji turned around, gazing solemnly at Chen Nian: "Regardless of what happened ten thousand years ago, from now on, I will not let anyone hurt you again."

His voice wasn't loud, yet it carried undeniable resolve. Chen Nian's eyes were completely reddened; the grievances and longing of all these years turned into two streams of clear tears in this moment.

choices.text: Press for more information from Chen Tianming
choices.description: Since Chen Tianming could leave this testament, it meant he had long calculated today's events, and there should be more hints he hadn't yet revealed.
choices.visible_cost: May consume more Heavenly Fate Value
choices.visible_reward: Obtain guidance for the next stage of the mission
choices.risk_hint: Chen Tianming's lingering will may dissipate because of this

text.content:
Chen Ji stepped forward, cupping his hands toward Chen Tianming's lingering will and saying: "Ancestor, since you long calculated today, may I ask—where is the flaw in the Heavenly Eye?"

The lingering will smiled faintly, and a trace of approval appeared in those ancient eyes: "You are more composed than this old man imagined. The answer lies on the last page of the Tianji Record... but right now, you still cannot open it."

Chen Tianming's lingering will began to gradually dissipate, and the final testament echoed in the ruins: "This old man's greatest regret in life was binding the fates of two children together. But this was the only method to break the cycle... My descendants, I hope you will not bear grudges."

Chen Ji watched as that figure of light slowly faded away, his heart filled with mixed emotions. The arrangement from ten thousand years ago had sacrificed not only him and Chen Nian, but countless others ensnared by fate.

dialogue.content:
"I hold no grudge." Chen Nian's voice softly sounded, "Brother, I am actually grateful. If not for this fate, we might never have met."

She lifted her head; those clear eyes held no resentment, only tenderness and resolve: "Regardless of whose arrangement this was, to become your sister, to face all of this together with you—I feel very fortunate."

text.content:
Chen Ji was stunned.

Throughout his life, he had been meticulous in planning, cold and decisive. For the arrangement, he could sacrifice everything, including himself. But at this moment, facing his sister's unreserved trust and dependence, his long-frozen heart actually trembled slightly.

He thought of many things. He remembered depending on each other with Chen Nian in the dilapidated thatched cottage in their childhood, remembered the helplessness and despair when she was taken away, remembered the loneliness of walking the martial world alone all these years.

dialogue.content:
Mo Xiansheng quietly watched this scene, a trace of emotion appearing in those ancient eyes. He softly said, "If Chen Tianming could see today, he would surely be very pleased. His descendants were not crushed by fate, but found each other within fate."

He paused, then continued: "Chen Ji, Chen Nian, your bond is deeper than this old man imagined. This bond will be your greatest reliance against the Heavenly Eye."

text.content: Chen Ji stretched out his hand, faint golden light manifesting at his fingertips. He looked at Chen Nian and softly said, "Sister, are you willing?" Chen Nian毫不hesitated地将手覆上他的掌心，两人的血脉在这一刻产生了奇异的共鸣。一道金色的纹路从他们交握的手中蔓延开来，形成了一个完整的圆环——"共命"之约，正式缔结。

choices.text: "First explore the other secrets within the ruins"
choices.description: "Chen Tianming's remnant soul mentioned that the last page of the Tianji Record hides secrets—there should be other gains here."
choices.visible_cost: "Consuming time, possibly being discovered by the outside world"
choices.visible_reward: "May obtain the secret treasures left by Chen Tianming"

text.content: Chen Ji did not rush to form the contract. Instead, he gazed into the depths of the ruins and walked slowly forward. On an ancient stone wall, he discovered a hidden recess. Reaching inside, his fingertips touched a cold jade slip—it was Chen Tianming's cultivation insights, recording how to more efficiently utilize the abilities of the Tianji Record.

Outside the ruins, the aftermath of battle was gradually subsiding. Han Lie, trapped by the formation Chen Ji had secretly arranged, was furiously attacking the surrounding restrictions, yet could never break free. He did not know that the disciple he had deemed useless was now within the ruins' depths, unveiling truths sealed ten thousand years ago.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly solidified considerably, and within those eyes that had witnessed countless vicissitudes, memories from ten thousand years ago surfaced. His voice grew low and solemn: "Chen Ji, the time has come. There are some things you should know now."

Chen Ji looked up to see Mo Xiansheng's phantom undergoing transformation—the aged form was gradually shedding away, replaced by a middle-aged man holding a vermillion brush and clad in dark robes. Upon him radiated an indescribable might—that is the bearing only those who control fate possess.

dialogue.content:
"I am Mo Xiansheng—but before that, I had another identity." The dark-robed figure spoke slowly, his voice carrying ten thousand years of沉淀: "Ten thousand years ago, I was the chief scribe under the Eye of Heavenly Dao, responsible for compiling the Ledger of Fate. Chen Tianming's name was written by my own hand."

He raised the vermillion brush in his hand and gently tapped the void. A streak of golden light entered Chen Ji's brow center: "From this day forth, you are the true inheritor of the Tianji Record. And I shall devote everything to help you break this ten-thousand-year cycle."

text.content:
Chen Ji felt a torrential flood of information pour into his mind—Mo Xiansheng's accumulation over ten thousand years—weaknesses of the Eye of Heavenly Dao, attempts by previous breakers of fate, how to mend the Tianji Record's incompleteness. His eyes flashed brilliantly, the corners of his mouth lifting slightly:

"So that's how it is... Eye of Heavenly Dao, you have laid out a chess game spanning ten thousand years, yet never expected someone like me to appear on the board?"

He gazed at Chen Nian beside him, then at Mo Xiansheng transformed into the dark-robed appearance, and an unprecedented fighting spirit surged within him. The truth from ten thousand years ago had been revealed, and his own chess game was only beginning.
